title: Ops Lattice Connector: lightweight runtime bridge for taskified runbooks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a small, runtime-facing adapter (the Ops Lattice Connector) that makes existing runbooks (playbooks) executable as first-class tasks in the operator task graph. The connector will expose a compact RPC + event contract so runbooks can be invoked by service-side triggers (alerts, scheduled jobs, API calls) and return structured step-level outputs, idempotency tokens, and checkpoint snapshots. Goal: enable fast migration of high-value manual ops flows to automated, observable runlets without a heavy rewrite of current scripts or operator tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Connector implements RPC 1.0 contract: invoke(task_id, inputs, dry_run) -> run_id
Runbook tasks emit step-level structured events and final verdict (success/fail) to telemetry with consistent schema
Support for idempotency tokens so retries are safe (at-least-once semantics turned into at-most-once effects)
Dry-run mode returns estimated side effects and a summarized plan without mutating resources
Connector includes a lightweight Python/Go client and example Helm chart for Private deployments
End-to-end smoke test: convert 2 existing ops playbooks to taskified runlets and validate on staging

Eng review (Ravi Patel): Suggest adding a 'compensating_action' field to structured outputs to help automatic rollbacks. Raised draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-lattice/pull/18
Security (Lena Östergård): KMS integration required for secrets; mark security_review_required=true
QA (Samir Gupta): Need acceptance tests for at-least-once->at-most-once semantics and for dry-run parity
implementation_notes: Connector is intentionally minimal: 3 endpoints (invoke/status/cancel). Uses protobuf for wire-format and Kafka for step event streaming. We'll provide a shim that translates legacy shell steps into containerized tasks with timeout and sandboxing. Retry semantics: retries attach the same idempotency token by default. Checkpoint snapshots stored in Redis for fast resume.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental double-mutation during retries. Mitigation: require explicit idempotency token and runlets perform precondition checks before mutating resources
Risk: secret leakage when running legacy scripts. Mitigation: mount secrets via KMS-backed files and inject ephemeral environment vars; enforce no-stdout-secrets policy
Risk: operator confusion with new UI. Mitigation: canary rollout + UX walkthroughs and inline help
